summary: Remove the unused status activity timestamp projection

replay.detail: Native presence refresh, status reads and one-time DND adoption are unchanged.

schema.detail: No status record, heartbeat, legacy reader or stored-format changes.

rules.detail: Only the uncalled status::activity_time_ms wrapper, its private activity_time_at helper and the one test of that helper are removed. All remaining status code and tests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Removes one unused workspace Rust function. Unknown external source consumers are not claimed absent and must remove any use. Published client, wire, CLI and stored-format contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart required for removal of uncalled code.

manual.detail: No operator action or state cleanup required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the projection without changing stored state.
